summary: On August 12, 2026 the IRS released Notice 2026-49, proposing sample forms and standardized procedures for rollovers between employer retirement plans and IRAs under SECURE 2.0 Section 324 (IRA-to-IRA transfers aren't covered). It's still a draft: the IRS is taking public comments through October 23, 2026, so nothing is final or mandatory yet.
suggestedAction: No action needed now. When you eventually roll your 401(k)/403(b) over to an IRA at retirement, expect a more standardized paperwork process; revisit once the IRS finalizes the procedure.

summary: Bond tent glide path recommended: begin de-risking at 54–55, trough ~60/40 stocks/bonds at retirement (60), drift back to 70–80% equity by mid-70s. Target 4% withdrawal rate for planning, not 4.7%. Build bond sleeve inside 401(k). Revisit at 54–55, 58, 60 based on CAPE.

source: jlcollinsnh.com — JL Collins, "JL Goes International, and to ETFs...... Oh my!" (Feb 8, 2026)
summary: JL Collins reversed a position he'd held publicly for over a decade: he added international equity exposure (moving toward Vanguard's Total World Stock fund/ETF, VTWAX/VT) and shifted part of his holdings to ETFs, departing from the 'just VTSAX, US-only is enough' foundation of the Simple Path to Wealth. This is a structural/philosophical revision to a foundational Simple-Path assumption, not routine fund commentary.
suggestedAction: No action needed — your FZROX/FTIHX 70/30 taxable brokerage already carries a 30% international allocation, so you're already positioned the way Collins is now moving toward. Logged for reference only.
